# Sayyid Edition

> An unofficial GTA VI fan-art gallery starring Sayyid Khan, with a Singapore Missions collection set around Singapore.

Each wallpaper has a full-resolution PNG and a WebP thumbnail. The gallery viewer supports individual PNG downloads. The Download all button creates a ZIP of the complete collection in the browser.

## Gallery

- [Live gallery](https://sayyid-vice-gallery.promptalchemistlabs.chatgpt.site/) — browse all wallpapers.
- [Singapore Missions](https://sayyid-vice-gallery.promptalchemistlabs.chatgpt.site/#singapore-missions) — open the Singapore collection, including Changi Getaway, Singapore Grand Prix, and Jurong Afterburn.
- [Artwork catalog](https://sayyid-vice-gallery.promptalchemistlabs.chatgpt.site/gallery.js) — titles, collection names, and paths for each PNG and thumbnail. Resolve paths against the live gallery root.

## Project

- [README](https://raw.githubusercontent.com/sayyidkhan/gta6-sayyid-vice-gallery/main/README.md) — gallery features, local setup, and file layout.
- [Source repository](https://github.com/sayyidkhan/gta6-sayyid-vice-gallery) — site source and wallpaper assets.
